verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.capacities.io (HTTP 200, describing the documentation). The docs are also served as raw markdown endpoints (/raw/...md), and the developer docs link a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific usage guidance, and no independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
